p:
Can we use a different frontend framework?
Only if it directly enables your selected middleware. Framework migration is not judged and is likely a poor use of the three days.

Can we use mock users or data?
Yes. Track B should prefer a small, deterministic mock resource over a complex third-party integration.

Must Track C use veFaaS Cloud Sandbox?
No. Teams may harden the supplied local container Runtime or use veFaaS. The new boundary and threat-specific controls must be real and clearly demonstrated; merely showing the Starter Kit's default limits is insufficient.

Can Track A show Codex logs?
Logs may be an input, but the result must correlate a Run into structured steps and make the failure diagnosable.

Can we add features from another track?
You may, but they do not compensate for an incomplete selected track. Keep the demo and architecture focused.

Must the final demo run on ECS?
No. The default development and judging path is the local Docker/Colima/Podman POC. Use ECS only when it materially supports the selected middleware design.
